title: sb-payouts memo v1
description: UTF-8 JSON carried in Memo.memo(...) memoData. At most 256 bytes. Public forever: opaque references only. memoId = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(bytes16 batchId, uint32 rowIndex)).

v.description: Schema version. Decoders refuse anything else.

b.description: Batch id: bytes16 as 32 lowercase hex characters, no 0x.

ref.description: Opaque reference from the CSV. Never a name, email or note.
